Visa Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Results
San Francisco, CA, July 28, 2026 – Visa (NYSE: V)
•GAAP net income of $5.6B or $2.97 per share and non-GAAP net income of $6.3B or $3.32 per share
•Net revenue of $11.6B, an increase of 14%, or 13% on a constant-dollar basis
•Growth in payments volume, cross-border volume and processed transactions was strong
•Share repurchases and dividends of $6.2B
